title: I love Hole!  Here’s why I think you should also give Hole a try! #Ed...
transcript: What if I told you that the best show that I saw at fringe this year is about a doomsday cult that, how should I say this? Avoids the apocalypse by keeping their hole plugged at all times? It is a truly absurd premise that should not work as well as it does. It is written and performed by these two performers, also known as American Sing Song. They are not only playing every character, but they are also doing all the music and doing all of the Foley. And, man, there are so many fun moments of Foley in the show, but the writing is just so clever and witty. And every time you think, okay, they have done everything they possibly can with this premise, they manage to take the story in a completely new direction. That opens up so many new opportunities for comedy and also keeps the story moving at a very brisk pace. So much of the fun of the show comes with those twists and turns, so I won't spoil it, but I will say that despite the fact that the show is silly and absurd at its core, there is actually a very touching love story, and one that, despite all of the craziness happening around it, you are still incredibly invested in from start to finish. And that's kind of the brilliance of hole. It lures you in on this insane premise, but then gives you a story that not only delivers On that absurd premise, but also is incredibly human and has something to say that isn't just ha ha ha. Butt plugs are funny. If you are at fringe, see the show. If you are not at fringe, this is one to keep an eye on cause I really think this is going to have a very bright future.
